title: No bind step at Witch's Cabin
caption: At Lv 5 on The Being Beneath the Lake the "Bind with the Witch's Cabin Kibelisk" step is gone: the game binds it when you reach the journal.

title: No Kibelisk note where it binds itself
caption: At Lv 12 on Veiled Truth the first step no longer says (Kibelisk: Quai Campsite): it is within 25 m, so the bind happens there.
